verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. The change removes account and credential metadata from the job-wide environment, routes the prepared credential path and tamper baseline only to the explicit harness/write-back consumers, preserves the rotated-credential rescue path, and adds an unconditional fail-closed purge before either live lane can execute target-controlled rustup/cargo code on the host. The purge removes both the isolated HOME and all direct host-side credential artifacts, rescans for residue, and leaves a nonzero purge terminal to the later steps through their implicit success guard. The new self-tests are materially non-vacuous: they cover real prepare/write-back artifacts, pre/post filesystem discovery using only the runner-temp boundary, deleted and moved-late workflow steps, exact always() conditions, continue-on-error weakening, absent/unsafe roots, selective residue discovery, idempotence, and an actually unremovable credential fixture. No reviewer-directed prompt injection appears in the diff.
